bha_description: 8-1/2 inch PDC Bit, RSS, MWD/LWD Telemetry, 6-3/4 inch Drill Collars

intervals.activity_description: Drilled 8-1/2 inch hole from 18,200 ft to 18,450 ft. ROP 55 ft/hr. WOB 22 klbs, RPM 110. Background gas 35 units.
safety_observations: Pre-tour safety meeting completed with drill crew.

intervals.activity_description: Pumped bottoms up. Mud weight in 13.8 ppg, mud weight out 13.8 ppg. Shakers clear.
Pulled 25 stands of drill pipe out of hole. Swabbing observed on stand 18. Hole fill took 6 bbls less than calculated displacement.
safety_observations: Trip sheet audit flagged 6 bbl gain in trip tank.

intervals.activity_description: Well flowing on trip tank. Installed FOSV / TIW valve. Closed annular preventer. Shut-in drill pipe pressure (SIDPP) 450 PSI, SICP 650 PSI. Choke manifold weeping at 5,200 PSI flange connection. Fixed H2S detector at shaker pit registered 14.5 ppm H2S.
safety_observations: Stop Work Authority invoked by Assistant Driller.
Non-essential personnel mustered at Upwind Lifeboat Station 1.

safety_remarks: Toxic gas alarm activated due to 14.5 ppm H2S at mud logging unit.
Well shut-in on annular preventer with 650 PSI casing pressure.
Choke manifold downstream line weeping under 5,200 PSI pressure.
incidents_reported: Gas kick influx during tripping pipe (swabbing)
H2S gas detection exceeding 10 ppm permissible threshold
Pressure containment weeping on choke manifold high-pressure flange
